correctness.rationale: Exact factorization of phi(lambda(2^a p^b)) and lambda(phi(2^a p^b)) cancels p^(b-2) and yields a b-independent quotient. The auxiliary K divides phi(u); c(a+t-1) is bounded by max(t,c(a))+t-1 in all cases. For u>1, 2-adic valuation of Q is at least 1; u=1 gives an exact power-of-two formula and the claimed iff. Self-contained standard-library verifier checked 1830 independent exact values plus 257/65537 thresholds; no infinite assertion relies on this finite check.

value.rationale: The paper-studied natural commutation equation is completely classified over an unbounded two-prime-power support with all exponents, rather than a numerical interval. The Fermat-prime restriction and exact necessary-and-sufficient threshold, b-independence and non-Fermat parity obstruction identify structural mechanisms and exclude infinite classes. It requires no unproved infinitude assumptions and makes no unjustified downstream claim.
